name: null-protocol
description: 《NULL：無聲協定》— 三人合作 3D 密室逃脫（第一章：失聯設施）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
